name: Princes of Fantasy
source:
Royal brothers Prindze and Phrince are adorable rulers of Kingdom of Fantasy. They honestly fulfil their royal duties, such as going for walks in the park, eating cakes and having fun. But maybe, just maybe, their way of governance may not appeal to everyone.
Created as ugly as possible to match theme of crude graphics jam.
translation:
王室兄弟普林兹与弗林斯是幻想王国可爱的统治者。他们认真履行王室职责，比如在公园散步、吃蛋糕、尽情玩乐。不过，也许只是也许，他们的统治方式并不受所有人欢迎。

为配合粗糙画面游戏大赛的主题，本作被制作得尽可能丑陋。
